title: Mailbox id guard: accept a canonically spelled nil UUID as syntax, reuse the shared predicate, settle the unreachable route-miss echo
outcome: The mailbox-id syntax check rests on one predicate, separates canonical spelling from the relay-specific nil refusal, and has no untested dead branch.
acceptance: A canonically spelled nil-UUID mailbox id (mailbox-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000) on the read and acknowledge routes is treated as an unknown mailbox (404 naming it), not refused as malformed; non-canonical ids still get the 400. Shown by a behavioural test.

require_canonical_mailbox_id and valid_mailbox_relay_id share one minted-shape predicate, and the echo fallback in describe_mailbox_route_miss is either removed or documented as a guard for other callers.
